title: Designs on a round table cover
body: Meera is embroidering a round table cover of radius 14 cm. She marks six points equally spaced on the edge of the cover and joins each pair of neighbouring points with a straight thread, so that the six chords form a regular hexagon inside the circle. The region between each chord and the edge of the cover (a minor segment of the circle) is filled with coloured embroidery, giving six identical designs. The hexagon in the middle is left plain. To buy enough coloured thread, she needs the total area of the six designs.
